about: Public-domain page images of the editions the catalogue was transcribed from (catalog/method/books.json). The images are never committed; omrbench/fetch_real.py downloads the entries below to a git-ignored folder after the host itself says the file is public domain and the bytes match the pinned sha256. The list is EMPTY on purpose: no file's licence has been read on its host yet, and an id or URL written down from memory would be a guess (tests/omr/README.md, 'The real-scan tier').

editions.edition: Beyer, Vorschule im Klavierspiel Op. 101: Peters, Leipzig 1895 (rev. A. Ruthardt)
Czerny, 100 Progressive Studies Op. 599: Schirmer, New York 1893 (ed. G. Buonamici)

entry_example.title: File:<exact Commons file title>.pdf   (Commons) | the IMSLP file name
entry_example.sha256: <64 hex digits; 64 zeros while pinning, then the value `--pin` prints>
entry_example.licence_evidence: https://<the https page of the host that states the licence>
